mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_leading_snapshot (snap_date, market, short_sell_vol, short_sell_amt, lvrg_vol, invrs_vol, updated_at) VALUES (#{snapDate}, #{market}, #{shortSellVol}, #{shortSellAmt}, #{lvrgVol}, #{invrsVol}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (snap_date, market) DO UPDATE SET short_sell_vol = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.short_sell_vol, market_leading_snapshot.short_sell_vol), short_sell_amt = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.short_sell_amt, market_leading_snapshot.short_sell_amt), lvrg_vol = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lvrg_vol, market_leading_snapshot.lvrg_vol), invrs_vol = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.invrs_vol, market_leading_snapshot.invrs_vol), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, snap_date, market, short_sell_vol, short_sell_amt, lvrg_vol, invrs_vol FROM market_leading_snapshot WHERE snap_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY snap_date, market
